people.name: Ben-hadad
people.line: King of Aram who oppressed Israel

people.name: Hazael
people.line: King of Aram (Syria), anointed by Elijah.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jehoahaz
people.line: King of Israel, son of Jehu

people.name: Joash
people.line: King of Israel, son of Jehoahaz

translations.web: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.
translations.bsb: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz took back from Ben-hadad son of Hazael the cities that Hazael had taken in battle from his father Jehoahaz. Jehoash defeated Ben-hadad three times, and so recovered the cities of Israel.
translations.kjv: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.
translations.asv: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash smite him, and recovered the cities of Israel.
